title: 花式索引：配对取点 vs 子矩阵
code:
import numpy as np

a = np.arange(12).reshape(3, 4)
print("a =")
print(a)
print()

print("=== 多个花式索引同框 = 按下标配对取点 ===")
print("a[[0,2],[1,3]] =", a[[0, 2], [1, 3]], " 即 [a[0,1], a[2,3]] 两个标量")
print()

print("=== 想要子矩阵必须用 np.ix_ 或分两次索引 ===")
print("a[np.ix_([0,2],[1,3])] =")
print(a[np.ix_([0, 2], [1, 3])])
print()
print("分两次索引 a[[0,2]][:, [1,3]] =")
print(a[[0, 2]][:, [1, 3]])
print()

print("=== 花式索引一定是拷贝 ===")
sub = a[[0, 2], [1, 3]]
print("shares_memory:", np.shares_memory(a, sub))
sub[:] = -1
print("改花式索引结果后，源 a 未受影响:")
print(a)
print()

print("=== 但 __setitem__ 能正常改到源 ===")
b = np.arange(12).reshape(3, 4)
b[[0, 2], [1, 3]] = 99
print("b[[0,2],[1,3]] = 99 后:")
print(b)
print("注意：取值是 copy，赋值走 __setitem__ 能命中源 —— 两者语义不同。")
